name: Goulburn Valley

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: It has the world's oldest and largest plantings of Marsanne, lemony and delicate when young and gaining honeysuckle with age.
Chardonnay is peachy and buttery, and can grow complex with age.
Cabernet Sauvignon is ripe, warm and earthy, with chocolate notes.

blurb.text: A Victorian region in the Central Victoria zone. Shiraz is 29 percent of plantings, and Nagambie Lakes lies inside.
